history.missing: no history document at %(path)s -- prose has no legal home then; point REFLECT_HISTORY at the file or remove the knob
history.off: no history document is configured (REFLECT_HISTORY blank) => prose has no legal home in this repo; state it and stand down
history.ok: history document %(path)s is declared and stays off every scan surface
history.on_scan_surface: the history document %(path)s is on a scan surface (REFLECT_DOCS / REFLECT_READMES / REFLECT_QUESTIONS / REFLECT_FACTS) -- its 'as it was then' lines would be judged as live state
history.title: History document
knobs.sem.reflect_history: the history document: the only carrier where prose is allowed (configurable path)
